# Weddings.io™ Technologies

> weddings.io — The World's SaaS Ecosystem Celebrating Matrimony™

Weddings.io™ Technologies is the global SaaS platform for modern wedding planning. Venues, vendors, budgets, guest lists, and full event coordination — all in one ecosystem.

## Platform Features

- Wedding Venue Discovery
- Vendor Management & Booking
- Budget Planning & Tracking
- Guest List Management
- Timeline & Checklist Tools
- AI Wedding Assistant
- Multi-Cultural Wedding Support

## Coverage

Global platform serving couples across North America, Europe, Asia, and beyond.
